name: Fixed temporal CNN on 25x25 spatial RGB statistics
features: context_25 reshaped from 333 channel-major features to 9 channels by 37 chronological days: raw RGB, local mean RGB, local population standard deviation RGB

model.pooling: concatenate temporal global mean and maximum
model.head: Linear(128, 6)
model.loss: cross entropy weighted by training n / (6 * class count)
model.normalization: per-channel mean and population std over training samples and time only; std <= 1e-8 replaced with 1

geometry: Identical to the fixed spatial experiment: 10113 buffered training pixels, 30114 unused-ROI validation pixels, and all 14105 original test pixels. Cross-partition 25x25 contexts do not overlap.
selection: After each of 20 fixed epochs, average validation ROI accuracy within each of four represented species, then equally across those species. Save the highest score; the earliest epoch wins a tie. Do not refit after selection.
test: Evaluate only the frozen selected checkpoint once on the original test set. Compare separately with the already saved matched spatial GLM baselines.
limitations: Exploratory follow-up: historical test outcomes were already observed.
Classes 2 (M.guianensis) and 4 (P.ramiflora) have no unused validation ROI and are not validated.
One fixed architecture, seed and 20-epoch schedule; no multi-seed uncertainty estimate.
The model learns temporal patterns in per-pixel and neighboring RGB statistics; it is not a reproduction of the paper's spatiotemporal vision transformer.
Different ROIs in the same images do not establish independent plants, sites or years.
Keep the result even if this CNN performs worse than the frozen spatial GLM.
